```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Data

```{r load data}
##load in packages 
#install.packages("tidyverse")
#install.packages("ggplot2")
#install.packages("here")

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

## Loading in cleaned CSV from Reixin
here()
deer2 <- read.csv("data/processed/NC_Deer_Cleaned_2010_2020.csv")

##examining date column 
glimpse(deer2)

```

```{r theme}

jasleen_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "navy", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray20"))
```

## Further Processing

```{r process, echo=FALSE}
## Group deer observations by year and plot

deer2 <- deer2 |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    year = factor(year)
  ) |>
  summarise( 
    count = n()
  ) 


ggplot(data = deer2, aes(x = year, y = count, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "White Tailed Deer Observations in North Carolina 
    Increase Each year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Observations"
  ) + jasleen_theme



```

## Calculating Change Variable

```{r change}

## calc change in observations per year 

changeindeer <- deer2 |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(
    change_in_observation = count - lag(count)
  ) |>
  ungroup() 

##creating periods to plot 

changeindeer$period <- ifelse(
  changeindeer$year == 2010,
  "2009 to 2010",
  NA
)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2011, "2010 to 2011", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2012, "2011 to 2012", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2013, "2012 to 2013", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2014, "2013 to 2014", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2015, "2014 to 2015", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2016, "2015 to 2016", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2017, "2016 to 2017", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2018, "2017 to 2018", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2019, "2018 to 2019", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = ifelse(changeindeer$year == 2020, "2019 to 2020", changeindeer$period)
changeindeer$period = as.factor(changeindeer$period)

## filter out 2010
changeindeer = changeindeer |>
  filter(year != 2010)

#plot
ggplot(data = changeindeer, aes(x = period, y = count, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Change in White Tailed Deer Observations 
    in North Carolina Increase Each Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Observations"
  ) + jasleen_theme
```

> The first plot shows that deer observations between 2010-2020 have increased each year. The change in deer observations follows a similar trend, as it increases year to year. The highest increases of deer observations occurs between 2017-2020. We will compare the change in observations to the change in vegetation and urban landscapes during this decade as well with the WUI dataset. An important limitation is because our data is purely observational, there is a sampling bias present. Just because deer observations have increased in the decade, that does not mean that deer populations also increased. However, it is interesting to see this increasing trend because maybe more land has been developed in areas that were previously forested, and maybe that is driving up the observations. We will continue to explore this.

# Spatial Data Maps

## Spatial Data Import
```{r}
NC_map <- st_read("/Users/huangyiping/KalsiGivensHuangYang/data/processed/NC_map_joined.shp")
```
## Map Plotting

### HU_dif Map
```{r}
map_HU_dif = ggplot(data=NC_map) + 
  geom_sf(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, aes(fill = HU_dif)) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="darkblue",high="red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Changes in Housing Units from 2010 to 2020 in NC by Counties",
       fill = "Difference")
map_HU_dif
```

### HUDEN_dif Map
```{r}
map_HUDEN_dif = ggplot(data=NC_map) + 
  geom_sf(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, aes(fill = HUDEN_dif)) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="darkblue",high="red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Changes in Housing Units Density from 2010 to 2020 in NC by Counties",
       fill = "Difference")
map_HUDEN_dif
```

### VEG_dif Map
```{r}
map_VEG_dif = ggplot(data=NC_map) + 
  geom_sf(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, aes(fill = VEG_dif)) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="darkblue",high="red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Changes in Vegetation Cover from 2011 to 2019 in NC by Counties",
       fill = "Difference")
map_VEG_dif
```

## Interpretation

The three maps indicates that in counties that more housing units were build between 2010 to 2020, the housing unit density also increased, and the vegatation coverage decreased.

# Deer Map

## Data Import
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
df_deer <- read_csv("/Users/huangyiping/KalsiGivensHuangYang/data/raw/NC_WhiteTailedDeer_iNaturalist_public.csv")
```

## Data Wrangling
```{r}
df_deer_spatial <- df_deer[
  !is.na(df_deer$observed_on) &
  df_deer$observed_on >= as.Date("2010-01-01") &
  df_deer$observed_on <= as.Date("2020-12-31"),] %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(observed_on, "%Y"))) %>%
  select(observed_on, year, longitude, latitude) %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c('longitude','latitude'), crs=4269)
```

## Mapping
```{r}
map_deer = ggplot(data=df_deer_spatial, aes(color = year)) + 
  geom_sf(size = 2, alpha=0.5) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of White-tailed Deer in NC from 2010 to 2020")
map_deer
```
```{r}
map_deer_2010 = ggplot(data=df_deer_spatial%>%filter(year == "2010")) + 
  geom_sf(size = 2, alpha=0.5) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of White-tailed Deer in NC in 2010")
map_deer_2010
```
```{r}
map_deer_2020 = ggplot(data=df_deer_spatial%>%filter(year == "2020")) + 
  geom_sf(size = 2, alpha=0.5) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of White-tailed Deer in NC in 2020")
map_deer_2020
```

## Interpretation

The observation distribution of white-tailed deer from 2010 to 2020 is well-spread across NC. However, there are much fewer data points for observation in 2010, which we need to take into account while analyzing the deer distribution against human development.
